channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Vermont welcomed fifteen point six million visitors in twenty twenty-five, generating four point one billion dollars in spending. This supported over thirty-one thousand jobs and contributed eight point five percent to the state's GDP. Canadian visitation dropped twenty-eight percent, affecting tourism numbers.

Advocates in the Southern Adirondacks met in Lake George to discuss preventing human trafficking and supporting survivors. Warren County reported fifty-four missing children last year, with about eight likely trafficking victims. Support programs focus on housing, work, and addiction recovery.

Rutland Regional Medical Center is promoting lung cancer screenings this November. Dr. Bobby Tullos from Memorial Pulmonary Clinic emphasized early detection's role in saving lives. Lung Cancer Screening Day is observed on a Saturday this month.
State Police arrested Robert Mears in Brandon for threatening a family member with a weapon. The incident happened Sunday evening on Forest Dale Road.
